cn_steps: 在 Cinema 4D 里安装 Epic 官方的 Datasmith C4D Exporter，并让它与目标引擎版本匹配，否则导出的 `.udatasmith` 可能读不进。
在 C4D 中整理好场景、材质与相机，通过 `扩展 → Datasmith Exporter` 导出为 `.udatasmith`，把贴图放在同目录一起导出。
启用 `Datasmith C4D Importer`（会自动带上 `Datasmith Importer`），重启编辑器。
把 `.udatasmith` 拖进内容浏览器或走 `文件 → 导入`，在 Datasmith 导入选项里核对坐标系、单位缩放和材质导入方式。
导入后检查材质与贴图引用是否丢失，把生成的静态网格摆进关卡，并用 C4D 里的相机构图对照摆放。
en_steps: Install Epic's Datasmith C4D Exporter inside Cinema 4D and match it to your engine version, or the exported `.udatasmith` may fail to read.
Tidy up geometry, materials, and cameras in C4D, then export from `Extensions → Datasmith Exporter` to a `.udatasmith`, keeping textures in the same folder.
Enable `Datasmith C4D Importer` (it pulls in `Datasmith Importer`), then restart the editor.
Drag the `.udatasmith` into the Content Browser or use `File → Import`, and in the Datasmith import options verify coordinate system, unit scale, and material import.
After import, check for missing materials/texture references, drop the static meshes into a level, and compare framing against the camera you set up in C4D.
note_cn: 导出器与引擎版本必须一致；贴图路径丢失时优先在导出目录里补全贴图而非手动重建材质。
note_en: Keep exporter and engine versions in lockstep; fix missing textures by completing the export folder rather than rebuilding materials by hand.

cn_steps: `Datasmith CAD Importer` 通过 `CADLibrary` 与 OpenNurbs 内核读取 STEP/IGES/JT/SolidWorks 等 CAD 文件，先确认源文件格式被支持。
启用 `Datasmith CAD Importer` 并重启；导入时实际调用 `CADInterfaces` 与 `CADTools` 提供的内核做解析。
在内容浏览器用 `导入` 选择 CAD 文件，弹出「CAD Import Options」细分对话框。
在对话框里设定细分质量：弦高、法线容差、最大边长，以及是否合并共面、保留缝合边与是否生成碰撞。
导入后对生成的 `DatasmithSceneActor` 源资产执行「重新导入」，调整细分参数再烘焙一次，并核对面数、法线与碰撞体。
en_steps: `Datasmith CAD Importer` reads STEP/IGES/JT/SolidWorks through the `CADLibrary` and OpenNurbs kernels, so first confirm the source format is supported.
Enable `Datasmith CAD Importer` and restart; the actual parse is done by the kernels exposed via `CADInterfaces` and `CADTools`.
In the Content Browser use `Import` to pick the CAD file, which opens the CAD Import Options tessellation dialog.
In that dialog set tessellation quality: chord height, normal tolerance, max edge length, plus coplanar merge, sewing edges, and collision generation.
After import, use Reimport on the generated `DatasmithSceneActor` source asset with new tessellation values, then verify triangle count, normals, and collision.
note_cn: CAD 细分是质量与面数的取舍：细节件调小弦高，大场景先粗细分再按需重新导入。
note_en: CAD tessellation trades quality against triangle count: use tighter chord height on detail parts, coarse first then reimport for big scenes.

cn_steps: `Datasmith Content` 本身不提供导入入口，它是所有 Datasmith 翻译器共享的资产类型库：`DatasmithScene`、`DatasmithAssetUserData`、变体集。
启用后，任意翻译器导入的内容都以这些类型保存；在内容浏览器打开生成的 `DatasmithScene` 即可查看层级。
选中导入的 Actor，在细节面板的 Datasmith 分区里查看/编辑 `DatasmithAssetUserData` 携带的元数据（DCC 对象名、材质名、原始路径）。
用变体管理器（菜单 `Window → Virtual Production → Variant Manager`）从导入的变体集生成可切换的状态。
在关卡蓝图里按标签或元数据筛选 `DatasmithScene` 下的对象做批量材质覆盖或显隐切换。
en_steps: `Datasmith Content` has no import entry of its own; it is the shared asset-type library for every Datasmith translator: `DatasmithScene`, `DatasmithAssetUserData`, and variant sets.
Once enabled, content imported by any translator is stored with these types; open the resulting `DatasmithScene` in the Content Browser to inspect the hierarchy.
Select an imported actor and read or edit the metadata in `DatasmithAssetUserData` from the Datasmith section of the Details panel (DCC object name, material name, original path).
Use the Variant Manager (menu `Window → Virtual Production → Variant Manager`) to build switchable states from the imported variant set.
In the level Blueprint, filter actors under the `DatasmithScene` by tag or metadata to batch material overrides or toggle visibility.
note_cn: 运行时目标只需依赖 `DatasmithContent`；`DatasmithContentEditor` 是纯编辑器模块，别加进 Game Target。
note_en: Runtime targets only need `DatasmithContent`; `DatasmithContentEditor` is editor-only and must not go into a Game target.

cn_steps: 该插件面向 DeltaGen 与 VRED 的 FBX 管线，走 `DatasmithFBXTranslator`；它们导出的 FBX 常带变体描述与材质目录。
从 DeltaGen 或 VRED 导出 FBX 时，把材质文件夹、贴图和变体描述文件一起导出到同一目录结构。
启用 `Datasmith FBX Importer` 并重启，导入对话框会识别 DeltaGen/VRED 的目录约定。
用 `File → Import` 选择 FBX，在导入选项里指定变体描述文件位置与材质搜索路径。
导入后在 `DatasmithScene` 里打开变体集，用变体管理器切换配置，并核对材质与 UV 是否跟随变体正确切换。
en_steps: This plugin targets the DeltaGen and VRED FBX pipeline through `DatasmithFBXTranslator`; their FBX exports usually carry variant descriptions and material directories.
When exporting from DeltaGen or VRED, keep material folders, textures, and the variant description files in one directory tree.
Enable `Datasmith FBX Importer` and restart; the import dialog recognizes the DeltaGen/VRED directory conventions.
Use `File → Import` to pick the FBX, and in the import options point at the variant description file and the material search paths.
After import, open the variant set on the `DatasmithScene`, switch configurations in the Variant Manager, and confirm materials and UVs follow each variant correctly.
note_cn: 变体描述文件缺了就只能得到单套静态模型；导出前务必带上变体与材质映射。
note_en: Without the variant description you only get a single static model; always ship the variant and material mapping with the export.

cn_steps: `Datasmith Importer` 是核心：读取 `.udatasmith` 并把 `DatasmithScene` 转成关卡内容，同时提供 Direct Link 实时同步通道。
启用后把任意受支持 DCC 导出的 `.udatasmith` 拖进内容浏览器，或走 `File → Import` 打开。
在导入选项里选择生成方式（关卡/Actor）、是否合并静态网格、光照与材质处理策略。
实时联动：在 DCC 端装好 Direct Link 插件，在引擎的 Datasmith Direct Link 面板建立连接，DCC 改动会同步推过来。
要自定义导入流程时实现 `DatasmithTranslator` 接口并在 `DirectLinkExtension` 上注册接收回调。
en_steps: `Datasmith Importer` is the core: it reads `.udatasmith` and converts `DatasmithScene` into level content, and also carries the Direct Link live-sync channel.
Enable it, then drag a `.udatasmith` exported from any supported DCC into the Content Browser, or open it via `File → Import`.
In the import options choose the generation mode (level/actors), whether to merge static meshes, and the lighting/material handling.
For live sync, install the Direct Link plugin on the DCC side and connect from the engine's Datasmith Direct Link panel; DCC edits are pushed across.
To customize the pipeline, implement the `DatasmithTranslator` interface and register a receive callback on `DirectLinkExtension`.
note_cn: Direct Link 与 `.udatasmith` 文件导入是两条路径：做迭代用 Direct Link，做可复现资产用文件导入。
note_en: Direct Link and file `.udatasmith` import are two paths: iterate with Direct Link, produce reproducible assets via file import.

cn_steps: 先在灯光设计软件（如 grandMA、Vectorworks）里导出 MVR 文件，再经 Datasmith 管线打包成带 MVR 内容的 `.udatasmith`。
启用 `Datasmith MVR`，连同 DMX 相关插件一起启用，然后重启编辑器。
导入 `.udatasmith` 后，`DatasmithMVRTranslator` 会把灯具、GDTF 参数和 DMX 地址解析成 DMX 库资产与灯具 Actor。
在 DMX 库面板（菜单 `Window → DMX → DMX Library`）里核对解析出的灯具型号、universe 与 patch 是否正确。
用 DMX 控制台或 DMX 预览驱动这些灯具，比对舞台布光与 MVR 设计是否一致。
en_steps: Export the MVR from your lighting design tool (grandMA, Vectorworks, etc.), then package it into a `.udatasmith` with MVR content through the Datasmith pipeline.
Enable `Datasmith MVR` together with the DMX-related plugins, then restart the editor.
On import, `DatasmithMVRTranslator` parses fixtures, GDTF parameters, and DMX addresses into DMX Library assets and fixture actors.
In the DMX Library panel (menu `Window → DMX → DMX Library`) verify the parsed fixture types, universes, and patch addresses.
Drive the fixtures from a DMX console or DMX preview and compare the stage lighting with the original MVR design.
note_cn: MVR 里灯具依赖 GDTF 描述；缺 GDTF 时灯具只能得到占位形状，需补齐 GDTF 再导入。
note_en: MVR fixtures rely on GDTF descriptions; missing GDTF yields placeholder shapes, so add the GDTF and reimport.

cn_steps: `Datasmith Runtime` 让你在打包后的游戏运行时加载 Datasmith 内容，而不是在编辑器里预先导入。
启用插件，并在 `DefaultEngine.ini` 里把 Datasmith 运行时加载相关设置指向该实现。
在蓝图里取 Datasmith Runtime 子系统，调用加载 `.udatasmith` 的节点，指定文件 URL/路径与导出到场景的方式。
监听加载完成回调，再对生成的对象做材质覆盖、坐标校正和碰撞设置。
它是 Experimental：先用空关卡验证加载耗时与内存峰值，再接入正式关卡流。
en_steps: `Datasmith Runtime` loads Datasmith content while the packaged game runs, instead of importing ahead of time in the editor.
Enable the plugin and point the Datasmith runtime-loading settings in `DefaultEngine.ini` at this implementation.
In Blueprint, grab the Datasmith Runtime subsystem and call its load-`.udatasmith` node with the file URL/path and the spawn-into-scene mode.
Hook the completion callback, then apply material overrides, coordinate fixes, and collision setup to the spawned objects.
It is Experimental: validate load time and peak memory in an empty level before wiring it into live level streaming.
note_cn: 运行时加载在并发/线程上更敏感；正式项目里必须评估大场景加载卡顿与内存峰值。
note_en: Runtime loading is sensitive to concurrency and threading; profile hitching and peak memory for large scenes before shipping.

cn_steps: `DaySequence` 用 Sequencer 驱动一整天的时间变化（太阳/月亮/天空），适合开放世界的昼夜系统。
启用后在关卡里放置 `DaySequenceActor`，把 Directional Light、Sky、SkyAtmosphere、Post Process 绑定到它的轨道。
打开 DaySequence 资产（Sequencer 时间轴），用关键帧或曲线定义 0–24 小时的太阳角度、色温和云量。
在关卡蓝图里用 `Set Time of Day` / `Play` 节点按游戏时钟推进，或把参数暴露给天气系统统一驱动。
`DaySequenceEditor` 只提供编辑器 UI，打包只依赖运行时模块 `DaySequence`。
en_steps: `DaySequence` drives a full day of time-of-day changes (sun/moon/sky) through Sequencer, ideal for open-world day-night systems.
After enabling, place a `DaySequenceActor` in the level and bind the Directional Light, Sky, SkyAtmosphere, and Post Process to its tracks.
Open the DaySequence asset (a Sequencer timeline) and key or curve the sun angle, color temperature, and cloud cover across 0–24 hours.
In the level Blueprint, drive it with `Set Time of Day` / `Play` nodes from the game clock, or expose the parameters to a weather system.
`DaySequenceEditor` is the editor UI only; shipping depends solely on the runtime module `DaySequence`.
note_cn: 它是 Experimental：与大世界时间同步时注意 Sequencer 帧率与确定性，避免昼夜跳变。
note_en: Experimental: when syncing with a large-world clock, watch Sequencer framerate and determinism to avoid day-night jumps.

cn_steps: `DebugDraw` 是 `UE::DebugDraw::*` 系列 API，绕开 `ULineBatchComponent`，做高吞吐量、无锁、色调映射后的调试线/形状绘制。
启用后把代码里的 `DrawDebugLine`/`ULineBatchComponent` 调用换成 `UE::DebugDraw::Line/Box/Sphere` 等函数。
把绘制写进每帧的 `FDebugDrawContext` 回调里，避免在渲染线程加锁，从而支撑成千上万条调试图元。
用对应 cvar（`r.DebugDraw.*` 之类）开关和限流，只在需要时打开，定位只在调试构建出现的高频绘制问题。
因为它在 tonemap 之后渲染且是 Experimental，先在目标 RHI（DX12/Vulkan）下验证，再决定是否替换旧的 DrawDebug 路径。
en_steps: `DebugDraw` is the `UE::DebugDraw::*` API family; it bypasses `ULineBatchComponent` to draw debug lines/shapes lock-free and post-tonemap at high throughput.
After enabling, replace `DrawDebugLine`/`ULineBatchComponent` calls in your code with `UE::DebugDraw::Line/Box/Sphere` and friends.
Emit the draws from a per-frame `FDebugDrawContext` callback to avoid locking the render thread, sustaining thousands of debug primitives.
Gate and throttle it with the related cvars (`r.DebugDraw.*` and similar) so it is only on when needed, for high-frequency draw problems.
Because it draws after tonemap and is Experimental, verify on your target RHI (DX12/Vulkan) before replacing older DrawDebug paths.
note_cn: 色调映射后渲染意味着颜色/透明度与普通 DrawDebug 不同；对比截图时别把它当旧接口的等价替代。
note_en: Post-tonemap rendering means colors/opacity differ from plain DrawDebug; don't treat it as a drop-in match when comparing screenshots.

cn_steps: `Default Install Bundle Manager` 是 `InstallBundleManager` 的默认实现，运行时负责下载、打补丁并挂载内容包（chunk）。
在 `DefaultGame.ini` 的 `[/Script/InstallBundleManager.InstallBundleManager]` 配置安装来源（如 HTTPChunkInstall）与 bundle 定义。
启用插件后，通过 `UInstallBundleManager` 子系统调用 `RequestAsyncInstallBundle` 下载指定 bundle，并轮询进度。
下载完成后调用挂载接口把 chunk 内容加载进来，再用资源引用或 `MountPak` 取用其中的资产。
这是 Experimental 的平台级 API：先在目标平台验证分块、断点续传与挂载行为，再接入正式内容分发。
en_steps: `Default Install Bundle Manager` is the default `InstallBundleManager` implementation that downloads, patches, and mounts content bundles (chunks) at runtime.
Configure install sources (e.g. HTTPChunkInstall) and bundle definitions under `[/Script/InstallBundleManager.InstallBundleManager]` in `DefaultGame.ini`.
After enabling, call `RequestAsyncInstallBundle` on the `UInstallBundleManager` subsystem to download a named bundle and poll its progress.
When the download completes, call the mount interface to load the chunk content, then reference assets from it or `MountPak`.
This is an Experimental platform-level API: verify chunking, resume, and mounting on the target platform before wiring it into real content delivery.
note_cn: bundle 定义与打包 chunk 规则必须和 `DefaultGame.ini` 对齐，否则运行时会找不到要下载的分块。
note_en: Bundle definitions must match your chunk packaging rules in `DefaultGame.ini`, or the runtime can't find the chunks to download.

cn_steps: `Deformer Graph`（Optimus）让你用节点图在 GPU 上做网格变形，替代部分骨骼/顶点动画开销。
启用后在内容浏览器右键 `Animation → Deformer Graph` 新建一个 Optimus 变形图资产。
在图里把 `Mesh` 输入接到骨骼网格，用 Kernel/节点做顶点位移（风吹、布料、二次运动等），结果输出回 `Mesh`。
打开骨架网格体资产，在 Deformer Graph 槽位指定该图，并设置编辑期还是运行期执行。
在 Sequencer 或游戏里预览变形；`OptimusEditor` 仅编辑器用，打包只依赖 `OptimusCore`/`OptimusSettings`。
en_steps: `Deformer Graph` (Optimus) lets you deform meshes on the GPU with a node graph, replacing part of the skeletal/vertex-animation cost.
After enabling, right-click `Animation → Deformer Graph` in the Content Browser to create an Optimus deformer asset.
Wire the `Mesh` input from the skeletal mesh, use Kernels/nodes to displace vertices (wind, cloth, secondary motion), and output back to `Mesh`.
Open the skeletal mesh asset, assign the graph in its Deformer Graph slot, and choose whether it runs in editor or at runtime.
Preview the deformation in Sequencer or in-game; `OptimusEditor` is editor-only and shipping depends only on `OptimusCore`/`OptimusSettings`.
note_cn: GPU 变形图与 CPU 动画叠加时要关注顶点数预算，过量 Kernel 会拖慢半透明/蒙皮网格。
note_en: Watch the vertex budget when stacking GPU deformation on CPU animation; heavy kernels slow down translucent/skinned meshes.

cn_steps: `Derived Data Build Controller` 让着色器编译分发到多台机器，统一走 Derived Data Build（`UE::DerivedData`）API。
启用插件，并在工程/项目设置里把 Derived Data Build 的后端指向远程构建控制器。
配置 worker 主机列表与通信协议，让编辑器把 DDC/着色器任务交给 Build Controller 调度。
首次编译时查看 UnrealBuildTool 与 Derived Data 日志，确认任务确实分发到 worker 而不是本地执行。
把构建产物写入共享 DDC 供团队复用；清理缓存后对比本地编译与分发编译的耗时差异。
en_steps: `Derived Data Build Controller` distributes shader compilation across machines through the Derived Data Build (`UE::DerivedData`) API.
Enable the plugin and point the Derived Data Build backend at the remote build controller in project/engine settings.
Configure the worker host list and transport, so the editor hands DDC/shader jobs to the Build Controller for scheduling.
On the first compile, inspect the UnrealBuildTool and Derived Data logs to confirm jobs actually ran on workers, not locally.
Write build output into a shared DDC for the team; after clearing the cache, compare local vs. distributed compile times.
note_cn: 分发编译的正确性取决于所有 worker 的引擎/着色器版本一致；版本漂移会产出错误缓存。
note_en: Distributed correctness depends on identical engine/shader versions across workers; drift produces poisoned cache entries.

cn_steps: `Direct Mesh Control` 提供在视口里单击拖动、按表面选择来直接摆姿势/做动画的交互，底层基于 Control Rig。
启用后新建 `DirectMeshControl` 资产，或在 Control Rig 里加入 `DirectMeshControlRig` 相关模块。
在视口里点击网格表面选中目标区域，拖动实现推/拉/弯曲等直接变形。
把拖动产生的姿势记录进 Control Rig 关键帧或 Sequencer 片段，形成可回放的动画。
它是 Experimental：先在测试骨架网格上验证选面精度与性能，再用于正式角色。
en_steps: `Direct Mesh Control` gives viewport click-drag, surface-select posing/animation, built on Control Rig underneath.
After enabling, create a `DirectMeshControl` asset or add the `DirectMeshControlRig` modules into a Control Rig.
Click the mesh surface in the viewport to select a region, then drag to push/pull/bend directly.
Record the resulting pose into Control Rig keys or a Sequencer section to get a replayable animation.
It is Experimental: validate surface-pick precision and performance on a test skeletal mesh before using it on production characters.
note_cn: 选面精度依赖网格密度；低模上直接拖动会跳变，必要时先提高目标区域细分。
note_en: Surface-pick precision depends on mesh density; dragging on low-poly meshes jumps, so add tessellation to the target area first.

cn_steps: `Directory Placeholder` 提供一个占位资产类型，用来把「空文件夹」也纳入源码管理（空目录本身不会被提交）。
启用后（纯编辑器工具），在内容浏览器对着空文件夹右键 `Create Advanced Asset → Misc → Directory Placeholder`。
给占位资产命名，提交时它随文件夹一起进入 Perforce/Git，团队拉取后空目录结构得以保留。
当文件夹里真正有了内容，可以删掉占位资产，目录仍随其中的内容一起版本化。
它只在编辑器侧：别把 `DirectoryPlaceholder` 模块加进 Game Target，否则打包徒增依赖。
en_steps: `Directory Placeholder` adds a placeholder asset type so even empty folders get tracked by source control (bare empty dirs are not committed).
After enabling (it is editor-only), right-click the empty folder in the Content Browser and pick `Create Advanced Asset → Misc → Directory Placeholder`.
Name the placeholder; on commit it enters Perforce/Git with the folder, preserving the empty directory structure for everyone who syncs.
Once the folder holds real content, delete the placeholder; the directory stays versioned alongside its contents.
It is editor-side only: never add the `DirectoryPlaceholder` module to a Game target, or packaging gains a needless dependency.
note_cn: 占位资产只是为了让空目录进版本库；有内容后及时清理，避免无意义的资产堆积。
note_en: The placeholder only exists to version an empty folder; clean it up once content lands to avoid clutter.

cn_steps: `Discovery Beacon Receiver` 在 UDP 多播套接字上监听查询报文，并用引擎信息（版本、项目名、端口）回应，供局域网发现工具定位本实例。
启用插件，并在 `DefaultEngine.ini` 的对应分区里配置多播组地址与端口。
让局域网里的发现客户端（如 Pixel Streaming / 远程工具）向该多播组发送查询包，插件会用单播回复。
在防火墙与交换机的组播策略上放行对应 UDP 端口，否则回复到不了发现端。
用 Wireshark 过滤该多播地址抓包，确认查询与回复流量，并核对回复里的引擎版本/端口字段。
en_steps: `Discovery Beacon Receiver` listens for query packets on a UDP multicast socket and replies with engine info (version, project name, port) so LAN discovery tools can locate this instance.
Enable the plugin and set the multicast group address and port in the matching section of `DefaultEngine.ini`.
Have a LAN discovery client (Pixel Streaming / remote tooling) send a query to that multicast group; the plugin answers via unicast.
Allow the corresponding UDP port through firewall and switch multicast policy, or replies never reach the discovering end.
Capture with Wireshark filtered on that multicast address to confirm query/reply traffic and check the engine-version/port fields in the reply.
note_cn: 多播默认不跨网段；跨子网发现需要交换机开 IGMP 侦听或配置多播路由。
note_en: Multicast does not cross subnets by default; cross-subnet discovery needs IGMP snooping or multicast routing on the switch.
